title: Tracker for Compound
tagline: Track all Compound users and find big activities! Using covalenthq API to do so!
description: Track all Compound users and find big activities! Input address and get history. The user will input address and the output will be a list of transaction history. The idea is to help the community find activities in the etherscan history without checking etherscan. We created a 1 click button to do so.
how_its_made: We used the api.covalenthq.com API to help get data for the tracking. It helped us in finding wallet address that used compound. Track all Compound users and find big activities! Input address and get history. The user will input address and the output will be a list of transaction history.
